title: ReadingList
description: The personal reading list, split into current reads, next-up queue, and parking lot.

current.description: Books you are actively reading right now.

nextUp.description: Books you plan to start next, in rough priority order.

parkingLot.description: Books you want to keep on the radar but are not actively planning.

bookId.description: References the id field in books.json.

addedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this entry was added to the reading list.

note.description: Optional personal note about why or when to read this.
